import os,json,subprocess
binaries=['/usr/bin/php','/opt/cpanel/ea-php83/root/usr/bin/php','/opt/cpanel/ea-php84/root/usr/bin/php','/opt/alt/php83/usr/bin/php']
res=[]
for b in binaries:
 if os.path.isfile(b):
  a=subprocess.run([b,'-m'],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True,timeout=4)
  v=subprocess.run([b,'-v'],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True,timeout=4)
  mods=a.stdout.lower()
  res.append({'binary':b,'version':v.stdout.split('\n')[0],'exit':a.returncode,'pdo_sqlite':'pdo_sqlite' in mods,'sqlite3':'sqlite3' in mods,'pdo_mysql':'pdo_mysql' in mods,'mysqli':'mysqli' in mods})
print(json.dumps(res))
